steps.text: City Tiles randomly in a 4x4 grid; flip the top-right one to show the Pit of Tartarus
Epic Demigod Market: 1 random green, red and blue Epic Demigod, each with the other card of its color underneath
Shuffle the Demigod Deck; {n} faceup in the Demigod Market
{n} Favor Tokens above the City Tiles
Stacks of 6 Forest, 6 Mountain and 6 River Landscape Tiles right of the city
Bank: green, red and blue Element Tokens (or the Element Tray)
Each player: Action Board, Quick Guide Card and God Standee
Draw a random Divine Plan Card, rotate its dark square to match the Pit of Tartarus from your view; hide it in a white stand
Kronos on the Pit of Tartarus; shuffle the Kronos Action Cards facedown
Blight Tokens by the Element Tokens in the Bank
Remove the Pandora Demigod Cards from the Demigod Deck
Each turn your god must move to a different City Tile, never one with another god
Game ends when all Favor Tokens are used
Random starting player; play is clockwise
